synonyms: 響け! ユーフォニアム 久美子3年生編
description:
Kumiko's third year finally begins! With the concert band at Kitauji High School over 90 members, Kumiko is now the president and does her best with her final high school club activities to try to win her long-desired gold at nationals.

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

node.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm  
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily. She is very preoccupied with something she said to [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina) at a contest in junior high school.

__Height:__ 158 cm
__Instrument:__ Trumpet

A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko). Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school. She is stoic and cool, and tends to keep herself distanced from other people.

__Height:__ 171 cm
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

A third-year high school student. She is the vice president of the brass band club, and also leads the bass section. Like Kumiko, she plays the euphonium. Her standoffish nature has brushed people off time and again. Her red-rimmed glasses are her trademark.

__Instrument:__ Oboe

Mizore is a second-year student who plays oboe. She is a very quiet and introverted girl, and despite seeming hard to interact with, she has friends like [Natsuki Nakagawa](https://anilist.co/character/88923/Nakagawa-Natsuki), [Yuuko Yoshikawa](https://anilist.co/character/88916/Yoshikawa-Yuuko), and - despite past relationship troubles - [Nozomi Kasaki](https://anilist.co/character/120724/Nozomi-Kasaki).

She likes practicing the oboe alone outside the classroom, and frequently arrives at school early, hours before the start of her classes, in order to practice. She's the only student to arrive at school even earlier than [Reina Kousaka](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina).

__Height:__ 156 cm
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

Natsuki is a reserved girl who is seen rarely talking, and she has an aloof and calm attitude. It is later revealed that the second-years are like this because of an event which occurred the year before [Kumiko Oumae](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko)'s first year at Kitauji.

However, Natsuki is normally friendly to everyone, and tends to be mature and calm in most situations. She is also understanding of situations and takes everything quite nicely.

__Instrument:__ Flute

Nozomi is a second-year student who used to play flute for the Kitauji High School's Bass Band Club in her first year. She and most of the first year members quit the club due to a conflict between the first-year members and the third-year members at that time.

Sound! Euphonium Season 2 Spoilers: ~!Nozomi tried to rejoin the band as well as get Asuka's approval. However, Asuka initially rejected due to the fear of Mizore possibly being affected by Nozomi's sudden return, causing a negative impact on Mizore's performance for the competition. However, due to an unexpected move by Nozomi to talk to Mizore causing her to run off, the latter managed to talk things out with Nozomi and restore their friendship. It is also revealed that Mizore played the oboe for the sole reason that it was the only thing that connected her with Nozomi.!~

Liz and the Blue Bird Spoilers: ~!In Liz and the Blue Bird, Mizore and Nozomi's relationship develops further. Mizore becomes less dependent on Nozomi and decides to go to a music school after graduating, while Nozomi decides to go to a regular university.!~

__Instrument:__ Euphonium

Kanade Hisaishi is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a euphonium player in Kumiko's second year. 
Kanade has a courteous personality and great communication skills, and gives off a good impression to everyone who sees her. However, she has a secret side to her always-polite demeanor. Kumiko describes her as a "hypocritical courtesy" or a girl who is "superficially polite but rude in intent".

__Height:__ 156 cm
__Instrument:__ Trumpet

Yuuko is a nice, friendly and cheerful person who is also shown to have confidence, determination and a strong personality. She can openly and confidently show others what she is thinking through her actions, her facial expression, and her words.
However, Yuuko is also an emotional person as she can easily get annoyed or angered when something didn't go in the way she wants it to. Yuuko does acknowledges these flaws of her and tries to improve herself and gets over her own pride for the success of the band.
By nature, Yuuko will put great importance on the people she cares about that she will do anything she can to ensure their happiness and well-being. Sometimes, this leads her to make some mistakes but other times it elicits very noble actions from her. On the opposite, Yuuko behaves acerbically towards individuals she dislikes or someone she perceives as a threat to her cherished friends.

**Instrument:** Tuba

Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.

**Instrument:** Contrabass

Kumiko's classmate. At an elite junior high school for young ladies, she learned to play the contrabass. She joined the wind ensemble to continue to happily play music. She has a positive personality, but worries about her name.

(Source: Anime News Network)

__Height:__ 184cm

Taki is the new music teacher in Kitauji High School and serves as the adviser to the concert band club. He is also in charge of Class 5 of the second-year students. He is polite and has a methodical personality. He emphasizes independence in his students, and to this end he pushes them to reach their goal of going to the national competition.

__Instrument:__ Euphonium

She is a third-year transfer student from the prestigious Seira Girls School.

__Height:__ 163 cm (5'3")
__Instrument:__ Oboe

Ririka is a first-year student of Kitauji High School and an oboe player in Kitauji Concert Band Club.

She has a light and cheerful childlike personality who tries to build a good relationship with [Mizore](https://anilist.co/character/125960/). However, according to [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/133462/), Ririka is aware of her ability to pass off any rude or suspicious behaviour as innocence with her smile. When Ririka's interested in something, she starts from the beginning and goes step by step.

Her special skill is making friends.

__Instrument__: Baritone Saxophone

A third-year high school student. She is the president of the brass band club, and also leads the saxophone section. She plays a baritone saxophone. She has a kind heart as she leads the Brass Band Club.

__Height:__ 166 cm
**Instrument:** Trumpet 

A third-year high school student. She leads the trumpet section and is the madonna of the Brass Band Club who everyone yearns for.

__Instrument:__ Trombone

Shuuichi is a first-year high school student. He is Kumiko's childhood friend, and the two went to the same junior high school. He and Kumiko are not classmates in high school because they are studying different courses. He was originally a French horn player, but he gets to play the trombone after winning a game of rock-paper-scissors.
Kumiko's older sister. She is a college student and was a trombone player in a brass band. She taught Kumiko to use a mouthpiece when she was a child.

__Instrument:__ Tuba

Suzume Kamaya is a new first-year student at Kitauji High School in Kumiko's third year and a member of the concert band who plays the tuba. Suzume loves her older sister, [Tsubame Kamaya](https://anilist.co/character/301973/Tsubame-Kamaya), very much

__Height:__ 161 cm
__Instrument:__ Clarinet

Sari Yoshii is a new first-year student at Kitauji High School in Kumiko's third year. She is a member of the concert band, and plays the clarinet.

__Height:__ 151 cm
__Instrument:__ Tuba

Satsuki Suzuki is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a tuba player in Kumiko's second year. She is mostly friendly and cheerful who is a sociable person where she can become friends instantly with anyone.

__Instrument:__ Trombone

Kumiko's friend from junior high school. She admitted to Rikka High School, known for its marching band. She is the protagonist of the Rikka-centric spinoff novels.

She is a woodwind Instructor brought in by Noboru Taki to help with the Kitauji Concert Band on its path to the national competition. Her main instrument is flute, which she majored in, but she is also highly proficient in all other woodwind instruments. She is the youngest of the four instructors directing the band who is described as gentle with a sweet personality and her woodwind students describe her as a firm but good teacher.

As nice as she is outside of class, Niiyama is revealed to be as strict as Taki and Hashimoto during rehearsal and sectionals, setting extremely high standards for her students and forcing them to practice for hours every day.

__Height:__ 171 cm
__Instrument:__ Tuba

Mirei Suzuki is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a tuba player in [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko)'s second year. When Mirei was friends with [Satsuki](https://anilist.co/character/142965/Suzuki-Satsuki) in elementary school, they were called "Sacchan and Micchan", although she dislikes that nickname.

__Instrument:__ Percussion

Tsubame is a first year during Kumiko's first year. She is a fairly reserved and somewhat socially awkward girl. [Suzume Kamaya](https://anilist.co/character/330331/Suzume-Kamaya) is her younger sister.

He is the new percussion instructor for the Kitauji Concert Band, hired by Noboru Taki, his then college classmate, to help with the band on their path to the national band competition. He is an alumnus of Kitauji High School and a former student of Tohru Taki. He is fun-loving, athletic, and humorous, and is consequently highly popular with his percussion students.

__Height:__ 156 cm
__Instrument:__ Contrabass

Motomu Tsukinaga is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. He joins the band as a contrabass player in Kumiko's second year. Despite looking adorable on the outside, Motomu is stated as a very crabby boy on the inside. He hates being called cute or by his surname by others.
The assistant band director of the Kitauji Concert Band.

Tomoe is a second year during Kumiko's first year.

During the time leading up to auditions, Tomoe began to notice pain in her jaw when she played. Eventually, it started becoming difficult to play high notes. She later announced to the band that she would be stepping down from participation in the auditions, and instead would support them as concert band manager.
